locator: I q.2 a.3 co., tertia via: quod possibile est non esse, quandoque non est
interpretation: Reading A, distributive: of each thing that can not-be, that thing at some time is not. Read this way, the sentence gives only 'each thing at some time is not', which does not yield 'at some time nothing was' (LOGIC-QUANTIFIER-SHIFT-EACH-SOMETIME-NOT-INVALID and relayWithoutCollectivePossibility in AQUINAS-ST-I-Q2-A3-TERTIA-VIA-NECESSARY-BEING).
